<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/labor/types/new"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a new labor type for categorizing time entries on work orders. Labor types define whether hours are standard or overtime, specify a multiplier for overtime calculation, and can be scoped globally or per-site.

**Prerequisites**
1. **SiteId** (optional) - Use GET /api/v1.0/sites to obtain a SiteId when creating a site-scoped labor type.
2. **ProductId** (optional) - Use GET /api/v1.0/products to obtain a ProductId.

**Workflow Example**
1. (Optional) Review existing types: [GET /api/v1.0/labor/types](/docs/api/labor-types/list-labor-types) to avoid duplicates.
2. Build request with Name, overtime settings, and scope.
3. Submit: [POST /api/v1.0/labor/types/new](/docs/api/labor-types/create-labor-type).
4. Extract `Item.LaborTypeId` from the response for future reference.

**Minimal Required Fields**: `Name`
